investigation_notes: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Meridian Utilities (electricity retailer, customers billed in US Central time); Platform: on-premises Kubernetes cluster mu-prod, node range 10.33.0.0/16; Billing: the daily autopay charge run is a Kubernetes CronJob (default/autopay-charge-run, schedule '30 1 * * *', timeZone America/Chicago) that submits card charges through card-processor-gw; a ledger-reconciler compares payments to invoices hourly; Change management: CHG- identifiers; CronJob executions are recorded by Job name.
